_comment: Vortex - Minecraft: Bedrock Edition proxy powered by Spectrum. https://github.com/ybriismc/Vortex
name: Vortex
author: ybriismc@gmail.com
description: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition proxy written in Go, built on top of Spectrum. The downstream servers must run spectrum-df or spectrum-pm.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Vortex installation script for Pterodactyl.
# Downloads the release build from GitHub and prepares the server directory.

set -e

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates tar

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64|amd64) ARCH="amd64" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
    *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

REPO="ybriismc/Vortex"
ARCHIVE="vortex-linux-${ARCH}.tar.gz"

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download/${ARCHIVE}"
else
    URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${VERSION}/${ARCHIVE}"
fi

echo "downloading ${URL}"
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/vortex.tar.gz "${URL}"
tar -xzf /tmp/vortex.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C /mnt/server
rm -f /tmp/vortex.tar.gz
chmod +x /mnt/server/vortex

CONFIG="${CONFIG_FILE:-config.yml}"
if [ ! -f "/mnt/server/${CONFIG}" ]; then
    if [ -f /mnt/server/config.example.yml ]; then
        cp /mnt/server/config.example.yml "/mnt/server/${CONFIG}"
    else
        curl -fsSL -o "/mnt/server/${CONFIG}" \
            "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${REPO}/main/config.example.yml"
    fi
    echo "created ${CONFIG}"
fi

echo "installation finished, remember to set servers.primary in ${CONFIG}"
